caption: The image depicts a rectangular piece of fabric bordered by a stitched green and blue zigzag pattern, set against a plain beige background. The fabric, likely linen, features a variety of embroidered rows, each containing alphabet letters, numerals, and decorative elements stitched in different thread colors including red, blue, yellow, green, pink, and purple. Several rows show uppercase and lowercase letters of the English alphabet in various colors, with numbers (such as 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 222) included in between. There are also wavy stitched lines and small floral motifs, including stylized roses with pink petals and green leaves. The lower portion contains additional calligraphic letters in larger size, and multicolored borders separating some of the rows. The stitching is even and follows a horizontal pattern, with the design elements evenly spaced and covering most of the fabric’s surface.
title: Embroidery Sampler
